input.brief: Matte green steel travel mug with a leak-proof lid. Keeps coffee hot for 12 hours.
input.story:
A woman in a yellow raincoat waits at a bus stop at dawn. She sips from her matte green travel mug and smiles as the bus arrives.

Close-up of the mug in her hand, steam rising from the open lid.

She steps onto the bus, mug in hand.

expect.fixed_rules_product_line: One continuous take, no cuts; product as described above.
